name: Kuki Akira
source:
The youngest out of the three Kuki brothers who transferred to Nanashina Senior High School. Though he has a gentle demeanour, Akira is mysterious and his true character is hard to ascertain. He doesn't have any real like or dislike for anything. As a result, there is a dangerous part of him that can get tainted by anything.

[Translation of his [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/akira.html]official website profile[/URL].]
